audience: Brazilian companies that issue NF-e and NFC-e fiscal documents with FiscalHub

useCases.title: Look up the tax data for a product code
useCases.text: Search NCM codes by a code or description term, then read the IPI rate, CEST and unit of one code.

useCases.title: Simulate the totals of a sale before issuing
useCases.text: Simulate the ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS and invoice totals of an NF-e. Nothing is issued or stored.

useCases.title: Recover an authorized NF-e XML
useCases.text: Fetch the authorized NF-e XML for an access key from the SEFAZ, when the file was not stored locally.

useCases.title: Check documents received against a CNPJ
useCases.text: List the NF-es and events received against a company CNPJ, in NSU order. Pass the last NSU to get only new documents.

useCases.title: Issue or cancel an NF-e or NFC-e
useCases.text: Issue an NF-e or NFC-e for SEFAZ authorization, or cancel an authorized one with a justification. The tax authority keeps these records.
